cells.gaps: No source found says the strategy has been validated or approved: the minister unveiled it in July 2025, and in May 2026 the PATNUC coordinator said it still awaited validation by the competent institutions. No body named to carry it out has been found.
cells.note: Bill's ruling (messages-for-bill 132): a minister's launch is not adoption, and formal validation is needed. The minister unveiled the strategy in July 2025 and in May 2026 it still awaited validation, so it is a strategy being prepared, stage 2.
